messages:
Carla M: quick heads-up — we're doing a privilege-svc image update tomorrow 03:00 UTC to patch CVE-2026-0123 (container escape fix). Need sign-off on KMS signing flow and a short RBAC change for the baker service account.
Samir K: thanks. which image tag and registry? will this touch prod canaries?
Carla M: tag is rsec/priv-svc:2026-03-01-patch. we'll canary 1% in us-west-2 for 2 hours, then 10% if no regressions.
Jordan L: for signing we plan to use cosign + KMS. who owns the KMS key? I can wire the IAM if we have the key resource.
Elaine R: runtime folks: this build also tightens seccomp and drops CAP_SYS_ADMIN. it may break a couple of init containers that currently use mount namespace tricks. please list any workloads that rely on those capabilities.
Carla M: good call. early inventory: batch-importer and metrics-proxy still use hostMount in init. I'll open a follow-up ticket to update them.
Samir K: on RBAC — we need to grant the 'baker' SA permission to sign (kms.cryptoSign) and to push to the internal registry (artifact.registryWriter). Prefer granting to a short-lived role via delegation rather than permanent clusterRoleBinding.
Jordan L: agreed. plan: create a namespaced RoleBinding for baker in infra-build namespace, annotate with expiry, and a Vault lease that rotates its token nightly. That should satisfy least-privilege.
Leo (oncall): FYI oncall: if the canary spikes errors we'll rollback to :2026-02-20-stable. Please add an automated rollback hook in the rollout. Also ensure alerts for >1.5x error-rate and latency regressions.
Carla M: yes, rollback hook in the rollout config. alerting: will add alert rules for 5xx rate and tail latency p95.
Samir K: KMS signing snippet for reviewers:
```
# cosign sign with GCP KMS (example)
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/signer/cryptoKeys/priv-signer \
  rsec/priv-svc:2026-03-01-patch
```
Samir K: note: baker SA needs 'roles/cloudkms.signer' on that key. we should add an audit entry to capture who signs images.
Carla M: how do we surface signing events into our central audit? we rely on the image-scan pipeline logs today.
Samir K: cloud provider emits KMS CryptoKeySign logs to Logging/Audit. We should add a Logging sink rule that routes KMS SIGN events to our secure-audit BigQuery dataset and also emit a slack notification via audit-bridge.
Jordan L: I can add the logging sink. want the query to filter protoPayload.methodName: "google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricSign" and resource.labels.key_ring: "signer".
Elaine R: runtime ask: after signing, the admission controller will verify cosign signatures. ensure the public key is distributed to gatekeepers and added to the cluster config prior to rollout.
Carla M: will distribute. who will rotate the verification key?
Samir K: rotate every 90 days; publish rotation plan in the keystore repo. during rotation we accept old+new until grace window ends.
Leo (oncall): during the mid-rollout can we run a quick chaos check — fail the registry for the canary to verify graceful fallback?
Elaine R: we already have a feature flag for fallback to stable image. will enable for the canary.
Carla M: final checklist before tomorrow:
- [ ] KMS key permission granted to baker SA (Samir), ephemeral binding (Jordan)
- [ ] cosign signing job in CI using baker SA (Jordan)
- [ ] admission verifier updated with public key across clusters (Elaine)
- [ ] alerting and rollback hook (Leo)
- [ ] docs: signing + rotation + audit sink (Carla)
Samir K: one more: let's add a quick post-deploy eval run to our regression harness that includes the enclave-escape test and privileged-process smoke test.
Carla M: agreed. I'll queue the eval and tag infra-oncall.
security-bot: reminder: compliance checklist incomplete — need evidence of key access review and audit sink before final sign-off.
Carla M: noted — I'll attach the access review doc and link to sink PR in the release thread. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Leo (oncall): oncall will be online during rollout window. ping me if alerts fire. :eyes:
